components.unused: {{kind}} is a section of an OpenAPI document such as schemas or parameters and stays as written; {{name}} is the name of the item.
components.invalidRef: $ref is the OpenAPI keyword and stays as written. {{detail}} is the technical reason, in English.
info.fieldMissing: {{field}} is a field of the info object of an OpenAPI document, such as version or description. It stays as written.
operations.duplicateOperationId: {{earlier}} is the other operation, written like GET /users.
paths.ambiguous: {{path}} and {{earlier}} are URL paths with parameters in braces.
responses.mediaWithoutSchema: {{status}} is an HTTP status code and {{media}} a media type such as application/json.
